redReproduction: Two tests failed on baseline: importing an unassigned key returned nil; saving Kimi Key4 returned readOnly without writing. Both pass after fix.
rootCause: The firmware unassigned action sentinel (type 0, empty payload) is known but the sidebar importer rejected it, disabling both editing and saving. It now imports as an empty shortcut; explicit writes use supported type 0x73 and preflight still compares the exact original fact. Unknown/noncanonical actions remain read-only.

uiAndHardwareChecks.before: Mode 4 Key4 reported no key action; controls and write button disabled.
uiAndHardwareChecks.after: Controls enabled with retained Backspace draft. Explicit write succeeded with success modal, then independent read refreshed Backspace.
